subject: Coord: Joint marketplace demo w/ CloudOrbit + Nebula SI — scheduling & run-of-show
messages:
From: CloudOrbit Sales <cloudorbit-sales@cloudorbit.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: product@cloudorbit.com
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Joint marketplace demo — CloudOrbit + Redwood + Nebula SI

Hi Logan,

Hope you're well — we spoke briefly at Re:Connect last month. CloudOrbit is ready to list the Redwood image in the CloudOrbit Marketplace and Nebula (our SI) wants to run a joint technical+business demo for a mutual prospect next week. Can Redwood join for a ~45-60m walkthrough highlighting: marketplace provisioning, SSO/SCIM, and a live inference run?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jul 7, 9:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Wed Jul 8, 10:00–11:00

We'd like: 1) a short platform overview (Logan), 2) Nebula to cover integration architecture (Emma), and 3) a short Q&A + next-steps. Attached is a rough prospect brief.

Thanks — can you confirm availability?

— Aaron Park
Senior Partner Manager 
CloudOrbit

Attachment: prospect-brief.pdf (attachment stub)

----
From: logan.wright@redwood.ai
To: CloudOrbit Sales <cloudorbit-sales@cloudorbit.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — CloudOrbit + Redwood + Nebula SI

Aaron — thanks, this sounds great. We can join and prefer Tue Jul 7, 11:00–12:00 PST (45m + 15m buffer).

Logan will run a 12–15 minute product highlight focused on Marketplace onboarding and security controls (SSO/KMS). Marissa can cover pricing & commercial next steps. Sergio — can you own the live inference run and latency/cost notes (10m)? Karthik — can you join for technical Q&A on provisioning flows?

Requested run-of-show (draft):
- 0:00–0:05 — intros & objectives (Aaron + Logan)
- 0:05–0:20 — Redwood marketplace onboarding + security (Logan)
- 0:20–0:35 — Nebula SI integration architecture (Emma)
- 0:35–0:45 — live inference demo (Sergio)
- 0:45–0:55 — pricing & next steps (Marissa)

I've attached a brief agenda and a run_of_show doc — please review. Also note: we need a calendar invite that includes a shared Drive link with the demo notebook and a non-prod API key (short-lived) for the live run.

Best,
Logan Wright
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: CO-Redwood-joint-demo-agenda.pdf, run_of_show_v1.docx

----
From: Emma Torres <emma@nebulasi.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: cloudorbit-sales@cloudorbit.com
Date: 2026-07-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — CloudOrbit + Redwood + Nebula SI

Thanks Logan — Tue Jul 7 at 11:00 PST works for Nebula. A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood's live demo run against a small real dataset (5–10k tokens) rather than synthetic so we can show cost profiling?
- We'll need an architecture slide with where Nebula installs the connector (VPC vs marketplace-managed) to share in advance.

I've attached Nebula's slide deck skeleton and a calendar tentative invite (we'll send final once you confirm).

— Emma Torres
Principal Solutions Architect, Nebula Systems

Attachment: nebula-runbook-skeleton.pptx (attachment stub)

----
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — run-of-show + assets

All — quick internal sync before we lock the invite. Notes:
- Sergio: please prepare a reproducible notebook that reads from s3-test-bucket/cloudorbit/demo-input.csv and uses a short-lived API key (we will request scoped key from infra). Keep the demo inputs small to avoid cold-start variability.
- Kar: have the provisioning diagram ready (slide 4). Please annotate where KMS and customer-managed VPCs live.
- Marissa (me): I'll prepare a one-slide commercial summary and a follow-up checklist (PO, pricing tiers, marketplace listing steps).

Logan — can you confirm whether SOC2 evidence or a security blurb is needed in the customer-facing deck? If so, we'll include a 1-slide summary.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

----
From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — notebook & infra prep

Quick status:
- Notebook: done, using a 6k-token set, reproducible, and includes a short token-cost table.
- API key: requested from infra; should be issued by end of day July 6 (scoped, expiry 1 hour).
- Slides: I'll drop the notebook link into the shared Drive folder and flag the cell that runs the warmup to avoid cold-start jitter.

I'll also include a small snippet to show quantization profiles (low-latency vs high-accuracy).

Sergio

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_shared_runofshow

----
From: CloudOrbit Sales <cloudorbit-sales@cloudorbit.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, emma@nebulasi.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-06T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — calendar invite & final confirmations

Logan / Team — confirmed for Tue Jul 7, 11:00–12:00 PST. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudorbit-demo-9876

Final checklist included in the invite:
- Shared Drive folder with notebook & slides (link above)
- Scoped API key to be posted in chat at start of session
- Nebula to present architecture slide 4 (provisioning)
- Redwood to run 6k-token inference and show cost delta (Sergio)
- 10-minute commercial close (Marissa)

Thanks everyone — see you Tuesday.

Attachments: redwood-product-highlights.pptx (attachment stub)

— Aaron Park
Senior Partner Manager, CloudOrbit
